title: Full Moon Ghost Stories Cruise in Murrells Inlet
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the enchanting history of Murrells Inlet on a captivating Full Moon Ghost Stories Cruise. Glide through the serene saltwater marsh as local legends and ghostly tales unfold against the backdrop of a luminous full moon. Perfect for families, couples, and history enthusiasts, this 1-hour cruise invites you to relax aboard The Explorer, a certified vessel equipped with open-air seating and an onboard bar. Savor snacks and beverages while listening to tales of infamous pirates and hauntings that define the local folklore. A unique opportunity to experience the area's storied past under the moonlight awaits you.

- 1-hour family-friendly cruise perfect for all ages
- Learn about local legends, including tales of Blackbeard the pirate
- Learn about the full moon and it's affect on Murrells Inlet
- Enjoy snacks and drinks from the onboard canteen
- Departures vary monthly; arrive 30 minutes early for check-in
